verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a hosted AI app builder, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows v0's own source published under an open license. The GitHub evidence covers only the v0-sdk client library, with no license stated, and the GitHub integration concerns users' generated code, not v0's source. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
